summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing for RMC CLASSICS MVP. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed covering root, register/duplicate, login (admin + wrong password), /auth/me with/without token, score submission (asc for memory, desc for connect4), unknown-game rejection, no-auth rejection, overall + per-game leaderboards, games meta. Frontend: Home loads with brand-logo + 6 game cards + hero CTA; /register creates user and redirects to /library; /login as admin redirects to /profile; unauthenticated /profile redirects to /login; mobile bottom nav shows Home/Library/Ranks/Profile at 390px width; sound toggle icon swaps on click; all 6 games render, boards mount, and gameplay actions work (memory flip+match animation, snakes dice roll & CPU turn, connect4 disc drop with CPU response, RPS rounds advance, checkers board loads, crazy8 top card shown); leaderboard has 7 tabs (overall+6 games) and switching tabs works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Set explicit origins for production.
empty_stats() iterates GAME_IDS (a set) making key order non-deterministic; harmless but consider using an ordered structure for stable JSON output.
public_user does not strip password_hash explicitly (safe here because only whitelisted keys are copied); keep this discipline as the model grows.
test_credentials: admin@rmc.com / admin123 (seeded). E2E user created dynamically each run (e2e_<ts>@rmc.com / pass1234).
seed_data_creation: backend_test.py registers unique users per run (test_<uuid>@rmc.com, mem_<uuid>@rmc.com); playwright registers e2e_<ts>@rmc.com. Data left in DB but namespaced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all API paths. Public URL used for frontend testing = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Memory Match CLEARED banner sometimes not detected via naive brute-force flip loop in automation because same card gets clicked >1 time and moves inflate; the game logic itself works (verified via UI state). All 6 games have proper data-testids and are wired to /api/games/submit when user is authenticated.
